faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find quick answers to common questions about our AI astrology system.
faq.a1: Yes, we provide free trial tokens when you register a new account. You can also get free tokens through daily attendance check-ins. For advanced AI interpretations, you can purchase additional tokens through flexible packages.
faq.a2: Tokens are used as payment for each question asked of the AI, generating advanced birth charts, interpreting dreams, checking auspicious calendars, or viewing daily paths. Token costs are clearly shown before using each feature.
faq.q3: How accurate is the birth chart?
faq.a3: Highly accurate. The birth chart is constructed based on international astronomical calculation algorithms, precisely positioning the Sun, Moon, and planets at the exact date, time, and location of birth you provide.
faq.q4: What can I ask the AI?
faq.a4: You can ask about any aspect of your life, such as: What are my career strengths? What does my love life look like this year? What does a dream about flying mean? The AI astrologer combines your birth chart data to provide personalized readings.
faq.a5: We are committed to absolute privacy. Your birth details and conversation history are only used to calculate your birth chart and customize AI interpretations, and will never be shared with third parties.
faq.a6: Yes, Zodiac Whisper fully supports both English and Vietnamese. You can easily switch the system display language from the menu in the top navigation bar.
faq.q7: What should I do if a token payment fails?
faq.a7: If you experience any issues while topping up tokens, please contact support via the Zalo button, hotline, or email. We will verify your transaction and add tokens to your account within 5-10 minutes.
